changes.zh: 修复 `multifigures` 各列项宽使用 `\hsize` 而非按列数与列间距计算所得宽度的问题，以及表格总宽使用 `\textwidth` 而非 `\linewidth` 导致在题目等窄宽环境中溢出的问题；列数超出实际图片数量时现自动收缩
changes.en: Fixed `multifigures` item width using `\hsize` instead of the computed per-column width, and tblr table width using `\textwidth` instead of `\linewidth` (causing overflow inside narrow environments such as `problem`). Column count is now automatically clamped to the actual number of items.

changes.zh: 修复 `textfigure` 末尾缺少 `\par` 导致后续内容不另起新段、直接行内续排的问题
changes.en: Fixed `textfigure` missing a trailing `\par`, which caused following content to continue inline instead of starting a new paragraph.

changes.zh: 修复 `textfigure` 的 `min-text-width` 键不接受相对长度表达式（如 `\linewidth - 3cm`）的问题，现改为在排版时延迟求值
changes.en: Fixed `textfigure`'s `min-text-width` key not accepting relative length expressions such as `\linewidth - 3cm`; the value is now evaluated at typeset time.
